name: The Pain They Cause; Devil Gods
source:
A tale of three lifelong friends, whose once peaceful lives are thrown into turmoil by strange phenomena – one of them seemingly changes overnight.

Kenshi, once a kind and gentle boy with a positive attitude, suddenly becomes cynical and heartless. Yet, according to everyone around them, nothing has changed.
